text:
[4. CONSENT AGENDA ITEMS]
[BFC 26-057 [PT. 2] [PT.3]] - Report regarding amendment, which adds to the scope of
  work, extends the term, and increases the total compensation, to Agreement No. C-
  139201 with 3Di, Inc. for a fire inspection management system.
  Recommendation: That the Board approve the report and adopt the recommendations
  therein.
